title: someone who isn't selling yet finds the way in

criteria.text: A Member with no Page sees no shop controls, only their own stuff and one invitation
criteria.note: [V] /you always shows Your Pages with a 'Start something' link; with no Page the empty state is one line, 'You haven't made a Page yet. Tap Create to start one.', not an invitation (OwnPages.tsx). No shop controls are shown, which is the built half. Ticket #15 (T125, old)

criteria.text: The invitation names specific maker categories, with one worked example
criteria.note: [V] grep 'maker' and 'worked example' in src/app/you and src/components/member finds nothing. The wording is new user-facing copy, so it goes to Don (PM queue). Ticket #15
